headline: Stifel Reiterates Buy Rating and $50 Price Target on NewAmsterdam Pharma
summary: Stifel reaffirmed its Buy rating and $50 price target on NewAmsterdam Pharma stock.
why: NewAmsterdam Pharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing oral therapies for cardiometabolic diseases, making analyst price targets influential for biotech investors.

impacts.name: NewAmsterdam Pharma
impacts.why: An analyst firm reiterated a positive Buy rating and price target.
